web.description:
## Input
*string

style

(minimum: 0.7, maximum: 1.2)

Default: 1

previous_text string

Default: ""

next_text string

Default: ""

language_code string

Default: "en"

npx create-replicate --model=elevenlabs/v3

Copy

Check out the [model's schema](https://replicate.com/elevenlabs/v3/api/schema) for an overview of inputs and outputs.

```javascript
const input = {
  speed: 1,
  style: 0,
  voice: "Grimblewood",
  prompt: "In the ancient land of Eldoria, where skies shimmered and forests, whispered secrets to the wind, lived a dragon named Zephyros. Not the “burn it all down” kind, but he was gentle, wise, with eyes like old stars. Even the birds fell silent when he passed.",
  next_text: "",
  stability: 0.5,
  language_code: "en",
  previous_text: "",
  similarity_boost: 0.75
};

const output = await replicate.run("elevenlabs/v3", { input });

// To access the file URL:
console.log(output.url()); //=> "http://example.com"

// To write the file to disk:
fs.writeFile("my-image.png", output);
```

Copy

Check out the [model's schema](https://replicate.com/elevenlabs/v3/api/schema) for an overview of inputs and outputs.

```python
output = replicate.run(
    "elevenlabs/v3",
    input={
        "speed": 1,
        "style": 0,
        "voice": "Grimblewood",
        "prompt": "In the ancient land of Eldoria, where skies shimmered and forests, whispered secrets to the wind, lived a dragon named Zephyros. Not the “burn it all down” kind, but he was gentle, wise, with eyes like old stars. Even the birds fell silent when he passed.",
        "next_text": "",
        "stability": 0.5,
        "language_code": "en",
        "previous_text": "",
        "similarity_boost": 0.75
    }
)

# To access the file URL:
print(output.url)
#=> "http://example.com"

# To write the file to disk:
with open("my-image.png", "wb") as file:
    file.write(output.read())
```

Copy

Check out the [model's schema](https://replicate.com/elevenlabs/v3/api/schema) for an overview of inputs and outputs.

```shell
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPLICATE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Prefer: wait" \
  -d $'{
    "input": {
      "speed": 1,
      "style": 0,
      "voice": "Grimblewood",
      "prompt": "In the ancient land of Eldoria, where skies shimmered and forests, whispered secrets to the wind, lived a dragon named Zephyros. Not the “burn it all down” kind, but he was gentle, wise, with eyes like old stars. Even the birds fell silent when he passed.",
      "next_text": "",
      "stability": 0.5,
      "language_code": "en",
      "previous_text": "",
      "similarity_boost": 0.75
    }
  }' \
  https://api.replicate.com/v1/models/elevenlabs/v3/predictions
```
